title: Answer: vertebrates with a working upper brainstem, including decorticate animals and children

statements.text: Creatures that regulate many needs through the vertebrate brainstem are conscious, including all mammals, decorticate animals and children born without a cortex, and perhaps some invertebrates. Thermostats and many living things are not. Protozoa have affect in the technical sense but need not feel as vertebrates do.

sources.quote: One surely must conclude that it does feel like something to be these children.
Perhaps this line of reasoning will soon need to be extended to some invertebrates
